name: Raven-Code
description: A powerful coding agent that can write, run and debug code for one engineering task on this host, reporting its work live as it goes. Use this agent for a fix, a small feature, a script, or a failing test. It reads local files on this host too. IMPORTANT: it edits your files for real and has nobody to ask, so put the acceptance criteria in the task. It is stateful, so a follow-up to the SAME instance continues the same task: do not restate the whole task, that starts a new one.
owns: owns coding: writing, running or debugging code. Do not write the code yourself.
